dataset: World Bank country and region (English and Simplified Chinese) classification list
upstream_lineage: World Bank Countries and Lending Groups API (v2), the same classification used by World Bank Open Data indicators; fetched directly (public API, no credentials) and vendored verbatim so the newsroom's zh economy-name lookup is offline and reproducible.
use_limit: Country/region display names and classification groupings only. Not used for any indicator value.

additional_component.name: Unicode CLDR region display names (zh-Hans)
additional_component.description: scripts/build_economy_names.mjs derives most economies' zh display name from Node's bundled ICU/CLDR data via Intl.DisplayNames(['zh-Hans'],{type:'region'}), falling back to the World Bank zh name above only where CLDR has no entry. Node's bundled CLDR version is recorded in runtime/pi/assets/economy-names.json's header at build time.
